Mostly yes: the docs say where a September picture went and give the command to restore it, but they fall short on one picture and on why. I wrote the findings to `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/archive-phase-2/docs-check.md`.

- **Where it went and the command:** `2026/09/readme.md` lines 3 and 6 give the drive path and `node Server/archive-sessions.mjs --undo --months 09`. That command restores the whole month.
- **One picture:** `picture-archive.md` line 17 only says "copy it back by hand", with no literal command. The only scripted route restores 3,651 files to fix one.
- **Why:** the reason (disk went from 651 MB to 72 MB) appears only in `repo-size.md` line 52. The month readme and `picture-archive.md` don't say it.
- **Size mismatch:** the picture counts add up to 4,982, but the sizes don't. `picture-archive.md` lines 7-8 sum to 552.4 MB, while `repo-size.md` line 52 says 578 MB.
- **Unchecked links:** I didn't check the day links in `2026/09/readme.md` or the `2026/08` readme link, because I was told to read only the five named docs. The `task.jsonl` link in `repo-size.md` line 52 goes to a raw log, not a readable page.

I didn't edit any other file.
